map.不一定，年龄、肾功、肺高压也可升高；需结合临床与超声。: Not always; age, renal function and pulmonary hypertension can raise it; correlate clinically and with echo.
map.能替代心电图和造影吗？: Can it replace ECG and angiography?
map.不能，标志物只是佐证，ACS 诊断以 ECG、造影与医师综合判断为准。: No, markers are only supportive; ACS diagnosis relies on ECG, angiography and physician synthesis.
